ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels with less than 5% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixel coverage localized to scars and edge artifacts.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters are distributed across the central and mid-right lobe regions; several isolated white circular points (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) are scattered across the dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible pixel angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying by 3-8 pixels; most prominent jagged peaks are located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve on the lateral edges transitioning to a concave trajectory toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12-15 circular white/light-gray pixel clusters representing healed circular scars, concentrated primarily in the mid-lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly vertical, high-contrast white linear streaks are visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-contrast, textured yellow and white pixel masses (biological encrustations) are clearly visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of white circular scarring at the lower center-point where the lobes meet the peduncle area.
